responses.message: Can I have a drink? (40 orbs)

messages: Sure thing. This ought to fix you up nice and good.
I'll hook you up with the freshest brew we got.
Absolutely. We got the finest stuff on this side of Mother Worm.

suite.message: Sergeant Haunch came and basically waged war on us.
The young ones fought and mostly died. We lost Peegle, Tom Hollow, Young Mimic, your brother...
Now, this is all that's left of us. I guess Skycorps don't see us as much of a threat anymore, so they mostly leave us alone.
It's sad, but what can we do besides move forward?
